messages:
nora: quick heads-up: hit a puzzling flake where a DMA issued to a stale host PA after a fast remap. small repro in CI. anyone seen short-lived aliasing during remap?

vik: saw something similar last month. we do remap in two stages: publish new mapping, kick mmu notifier, then clear old entry. if readers race in that window they can observe stale backing.

sam: right. we debated slowing writers vs making readers detect it. writers are on hot eviction path so preferred guard on readers.

anya: one idea: instead of a 2-slot epoch, use a generation-id that writers flip (odd/even) and a sticky-read token for readers. Sequence:
1) reader samples gen before/after read
2) if mismatch, reader sets sticky token and retries (spin for short window)
3) writer increments gen twice around remap
Sticky token prevents repeated retries for hot readers once remap completes.

vik: sticky token sounds neat but needs per-thread or per-cpu storage to avoid contention. also must consider wrap; use 64-bit gen.

nora: what's the cost model? hotpath must stay ~sub-200ns. extra loads are ok but spinning must be bounded.

sam: microbench sketch: fastpath = load gen, rmb, load pfn, rmb, load gen compare. sticky token path increments a cpu-local counter and does exponential backoff up to 50us then escalate to notifier wait. We'll add telemetry for token hits.

anya: I'll add a small CI fault-injector: NOTIFIER_STALL_MS env var to force mmu callback delay and verify sticky path exercises. Also add a per-page gen_mismatch counter.

offload-bot: CI: run/host-remap-stress (gpu-16g) flaked 4/200 runs last 24h category=remap-ordering. https://ci.redwood.internal/recv123

nora: ok plan: 1) prototype gen+sticky-read (sam), 2) add CI injector + telemetry (anya), 3) perf run on perf lab and choose spin threshold (vik). If sticky-read looks good we avoid adding waits on writer evict.

sam: opening DRAFT PR now: DRAFT: genid-sticky-read-guard. Will include perf harness and CI toggles.

nora: thanks team. follow-up RFC note will include fallbacks: if sticky-read causes regressions we may need stronger writer quiesce invariant. tagging reviewers. :thumbsup:
